Name: Common Sensor Covariance Support Data
Description: This DES provides the stochastic modeled sensor errors and the unmodeled sensor errors for the optical dataset. It includes the definition of correlated parameter groups, adjustable Parameter (AP) uncertainties for each CPG, unmodeled error (UE) covariance and cross covariance, and a postieriori AP data.

DE.Name: File Part Type
DE.Description: This field shall contain the characters DE.

DES_ID.Name: Unique DES Type Identifier
DES_ID.Description: This field shall contain a valid alphanumeric identifier properly registered with the GWG NTB.

DESVER.Name: Version of the Data Definition
DESVER.Description: This field shall contain the alphanumeric version number of the use of the tag. The version number is assigned as part of the registration process.

DESCLAS.Name: DES Security Metadata
DESCLAS.Description: This field shall contain a valid value representing the classification level of the DES. Valid values are T for Top Secret, S for Secret, C for Confidential, R for Restricted, or U for Unclassified.

DESSHL.Name: DES User-Defined Subheader Length
DESSHL.Description: This field contains the number of bytes in the user-defined subheader.

UUID.Name: Assigned UUID for the DES
UUID.Description: This UUID refers to the entire DES, i.e., both the subheader and the data portions of the DES.

NUMAIS.Name: Number of Associated Image Segments
NUMAIS.Description: This field provides the number of image segments associated with this DES. If NUMAIS = ALL, the DES is associated with all image segments in the NITF dataset, and field AISDLVLn is omitted. Otherwise, NUMAIS is between 1 and 998 (999 is covered by ALL) and is no more than the number of image segments in the dataset.

AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Name: Nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLVL<NUMAIS>.Description: This field provides the Image Display Level (IDLVL) of each image segment associated with this DES. AISDLVLn shall correspond to IDLVL values of image segments in the same dataset. If NUMAIS = ALL, this field is omitted.

NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Name: Nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
NUM_ASSOC_ELEM.Description: This field contains the number of elements associated with this DES. For Level 1 and 2 conformance, this list shall include the IMAGE_UUID from the CSEXRB TRE for all images associated with this DES, as well as the UUIDs of any other elements that are authoritatively associated with this DES.

ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Name: Nth Associated Image Segment Display Level
ASSOC_ELEM_UUID<NUM_ASSOC_ELEM>.Description: This field contains the UUID of the nth element associated with this DES. The type of associated element is unrestricted.

RESERVEDSUBH_LEN.Name: Length of Reserved Subheader Field
RESERVEDSUBH_LEN.Description: The value of this field shall be 0000.

COV_VERSION_DATE.Name: Covariance Version Date
COV_VERSION_DATE.Description: This field contains the date of the version of the covariance implementation. For a given covariance version date, the fields CORE_SETS, REF_FRAME_I, NUM_GROUPS, and NUM_ADJ_PARAM are constant, i.e., if two images have the same COV_VERSION_DATE, these fields will be the same in both images.

CORE_SETS.Name: Number of Core Sets
CORE_SETS.Description: This field contains the number of core sources reported in this DES.

REF_FRAME_POSITION<CORE_SETS>.Name: Reference Frame for the Position Coordinate System of the nth Core Set
REF_FRAME_POSITION<CORE_SETS>.Description: This field indicates the reference frame used for the position coordinate system for the nth Core Set.

REF_FRAME_ATTITUDE<CORE_SETS>.Name: Reference Frame for the Attitude Coordinate System of the nth Core Set
REF_FRAME_ATTITUDE<CORE_SETS>.Description: This field indicates the reference frame used for the position coordinate system for the nth Core Set.

NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>.Name: Number of Independent Sensor Error Parameter Groups for the nth Core Set
NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>.Description: This field provides the number of independent sensor error parameters groups associated with the nth Core Set.

CORR_REF_DATE<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for the jth CPG of the nth Core Set
CORR_REF_DATE<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field reports the date of the last de-correlation event for this CPG. The date is formatted as CCYYMMDD.

CORR_REF_TIME<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Time Stamp of Last De-Correlation Event for jth CPG of nth Core Set
CORR_REF_TIME<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field contains the time stamp of the last de-correlation event for this CPG formatted as hhmmss.nnnnnnnnn.

NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Adjustable Parameters in the jth CPG of nth Core Set
NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field contains the number of adjustable sensor parameters in the jth CPG of the nth core set. This value represents the number of sensor parameters for which the covariance data in this group applies.

ADJ_PARM_ID<NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GROUPS<CORE.Name: Identity of the kth Fundamental Adjustable Parameter
ADJ_PARM_ID<NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GROUPS<CORE.Description: This field identifies the kth fundamental adjustable parameter for which the covariance data in this CPG apply. Sensor position x, y, and z parameters are in units of meters-squared. Sensor attitude parameters are in units of radians-squared, with w defined as the rotation about x, o as the rotation about y, and k as the rotation about z. Focal length parameters are in units of meters-squared.

BASIC_SUB_ALLOC<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Sub-Allocation Flag of Fundamental Adjustable Paramaters in jth CPG to Basic Adjustable Parameters
BASIC_SUB_ALLOC<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether the Fundamental Adjustable Parameters of the jth CPG are sub-allocated to Basic Adjustable Parameters.

ERRCOV_C1<(0.5xNUM_ADJ_PARM)x(NUM_ADJ_PA.Name: Sub-Allocation Flag of Fundamental Adjustable Paramaters in jth CPG to Basic Adjustable Parameters
ERRCOV_C1<(0.5xNUM_ADJ_PARM)x(NUM_ADJ_PA.Description: This field contains the kth individual error covariance terms within the jth CPG. ERRCOV_C1 terms represent the upper triangular portion of the error covariance (cross-covariance at t = 0) for the current image j th CPG. E.g., if NUM_ADJ_PARM = 3, then ERRCOV_C1 is a 3x3 matrix and the elements supplied, in order, are: C1(1,1), C1(1,2), C1(1,3), C1(2,2), C1(2,3), and C1(3,3). Units vary. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 1, 2, 3, or 7, units are meters-squared. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 4, 5, or 6, units are radians-squared. Given dimension n3 = NUM_ADJ_PARM, there are 0.5 x n3 x (n3 + 1) elements supplied.

BASIC_PF_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if SPDCF of Type PF is Provided for jth CPG
BASIC_PF_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a platform type SPDCF is provided.

NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Platform Type SPDCFs Provided for jth Group
NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates the number of platform type SPDCFs provided for jth Group.

BASIC_PF_SPDCF<NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_GROUPS<C.Name: Identifier of the kth Basic SPDCF of Platform Type for jth CPG
BASIC_PF_SPDCF<NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_GROUPS<C.Description: This field identifies the kth SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, different payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a related CSEXRB TRE.

NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC_PF<NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_G.Name: Number of Sensor Pairings to which the kth SPDCF Applies
NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC_PF<NUM_BASIC_PF<NUM_G.Description: This field provides the number of sensor pairings (sensor associated with this image and other sensor on this platform) to which this SPDCF applies.

BASIC_PF_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC.Name: Identifier of Other Sensor to Which This SPDCF Applies
BASIC_PF_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC.Description: This field contains the pth sensor identifier from a related CSEXRB TRE SENSOR_ID field to which this SPDCF applies (i.e., defines a correlation). A value of ALL means that this SPDCF applies to all sensor pairings.

BASIC_PL_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if SPDCF of Type PL is Provided for jth CPG
BASIC_PL_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a payload type SPDCF is provided.

NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Payload Type SPDCFs Provided for the jth CPG
NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates the number of payload type SPDCFs provided for the jth CPG.

BASIC_PL_SPDCF<NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROUPS<C.Name: Identifier of the kth Basic SPDCF of Payload Type for j th CPG
BASIC_PL_SPDCF<NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROUPS<C.Description: This field identifies the kth SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, same payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a relating CSEXRB TRE.

NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC<NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROU.Name: Identifier of the kth Basic SPDCF of Payload Type for j th CPG
NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC<NUM_BASIC_PL<NUM_GROU.Description: This field identifies the kth SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, same payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a relating CSEXRB TRE.

BASIC_PL_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC.Name: Identifier of the kth Basic SPDCF of Payload Type for j th CPG
BASIC_PL_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_BASIC.Description: This field identifies the kth SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, same payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a relating CSEXRB TRE.

BASIC_SR_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if SPDCF of Type SR is Provided for jth CPG
BASIC_SR_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a sensor type SPDCF is provided.

BASIC_SR_SPDCF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Identifier of the Basic SPDCF of Sensor Type for jth CPG
BASIC_SR_SPDCF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field identifies the SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, payload, and sensor as defined by fields in a related CSEXRB TRE.

POST_SUB_ALLOC<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating Sub-Allocation to Correction Posts for jth CPG
POST_SUB_ALLOC<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates if fundamental adjustable parameters in the jth group are sub-allocated to correction posts.

POST_START_TIME<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Date of the First Post
POST_START_TIME<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field contains the time of the first post, on the POST_START_DATEnj date, reported as the number of seconds elapsed from midnight. Note that this field does not support leap seconds.

POST_DT<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Time Between Consecutive Posts
POST_DT<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates the time between consecutive posts.

NUM_POSTS<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Posts
NUM_POSTS<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates the number of posts.

COMMON_POSTS_COV<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Common Correction Posts Error Covariance Flag
COMMON_POSTS_COV<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates if the same covariance is to be applied at all posts.

ERRCOV_C2<(0.5xNUM_ADJ_PARM)x(NUM_ADJ_PA.Name: Individual Error Covariance Terms Within jth CPG
ERRCOV_C2<(0.5xNUM_ADJ_PARM)x(NUM_ADJ_PA.Description: This field contains the kth individual error covariance term within the jth CPG. ERRCOV_C2 terms represent the upper triangular portion of the error covariance (cross-covariance at t = 0) for the current image j th CPG. E.g., if NUM_ADJ_PARM = 3, then ERRCOV_C2 is a 3X3 matrix and the elements supplied, in order, are: C2(1,1), C2(1,2), C2(1,3), C2(2,2), C2(2,3), and C2(3,3). Units vary. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 1, 2, 3, or 7, units are meters-squared. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 4, 5, or 6, units are radians-squared. Given dimension n3 = NUM_ADJ_PARM, there are 0.5 x n3 x (n3 + 1) elements supplied.

ERRCOV_C2<NUM_POSTS<NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GRO.Name: Individual Error Covariance Terms for the kth Post Within jth CPG
ERRCOV_C2<NUM_POSTS<NUM_ADJ_PARM<NUM_GRO.Description: This field contains the pth individual error covariance term associated with the kth post within the jth CPG. ERRCOV_C2 terms represent the upper triangular portion of the error covariance (cross-covariance at t = 0) for the current image jth CPG. E.g., if NUM_ADJ_PARM = 3, then ERRCOV_C2 is a 3x3 matrix and the elements supplied, in order, are: C2(1,1), C2(1,2), C2(1,3), C2(2,2), C2(2,3), and C2(3,3). Units vary. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 1, 2, 3, or 7, units are meters-squared. If ADJ_PARM_ID = 4, 5, or 6, units are radians squared. Given dimension n3 = NUM_ADJ_PARM, there are 0.5 x n3 x (n3 + 1) elements supplied.

POST_INTERP<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Post Interpolation Method
POST_INTERP<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field identifies the method used to interpolate between posts. Future values shall be registered with the GWG NTB.

POST_PF_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if a Post SPDCF of Type PF is Provided for jth CPG
POST_PF_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a platform type post SPDCF is provided.

NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Platform Type Post SPDCFs Provided for jth CPG
NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field contains the number of platform type post SPDCFs provided for the jth CPG.

POST_PF_SPDCF<NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GROUPS<COR.Name: Identifier of the kth Post SPDCF of Platform Type for jth CPG
POST_PF_SPDCF<NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GROUPS<COR.Description: This field identifies the kth post SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, different payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a related CSEXRB TRE.

NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_PF<NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GRO.Name: Number of Sensor Pairings to Which the kth Post SPDCF of Platform Type Applies
NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_PF<NUM_POST_PF<NUM_GRO.Description: This field identifies the number of sensor pairings (sensor associated with this image and other sensor on this platform) to which this post SPDCF applies.

POST_PF_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_P.Name: Identifier of Other Sensor to Which This Post SPDCF Applies
POST_PF_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_P.Description: This field contains the pth sensor identifier from a related CSEXRB TRE SENSOR_ID field which identifies another sensor to which this post SPDCF applies (i.e., defines a correlation). A value of ALL means that this post SPDCF applies to all sensor pairings.

POST_PL_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if a Post SPDCF of Type PL is Provided for jth CPG
POST_PL_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a payload type post SPDCF is provided.

NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Number of Payload Type Post SPDCF Provided for jth CPG
NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates the number of payload type post SPDCF provided for the jth CPG.

POST_PL_SPDCF<NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GROUPS<COR.Name: Identifier of the kth Post SPDCF of Payload Type for jth CPG
POST_PL_SPDCF<NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GROUPS<COR.Description: This field identifies the kth post SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, same payload, and different sensor as defined by fields in a related CSEXRB TRE.

NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_PL<NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GRO.Name: Number of Sensor Pairings to Which the kth Post SPDCF of Payload Type Applies
NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_PL<NUM_POST_PL<NUM_GRO.Description: This field identifies the number of sensor pairings (sensor associated with this image and other sensor on this payload) to which this post SPDCF applies.

POST_PL_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_P.Name: Identifier of Other Sensor to Which This Post SPDCF Applies
POST_PL_SPDCF_SENSOR<NUM_PAIRINGS_POST_P.Description: This field contains the pth sensor identifier from a related CSEXRB TRE SENSOR_ID field which identifies another sensor to which this post SPDCF applies (i.e., defines a correlation). A value of ALL means this post SPDCF applies to all sensor pairings.

POST_SR_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Flag Indicating if Post SPDCF of Type SR is Provided for jth CPG
POST_SR_FLAG<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates whether a sensor type post SPDCF is provided.

POST_SR_SPDCF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Identifier of the Post SPDCF of Sensor Type for jth CPG
POST_SR_SPDCF<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field identifies the post SPDCF to use for the jth CPG and other image products collected by the same platform, same payload, and same sensor as identified by fields in a related CSEXRB TRE.

POST_CORR<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Name: Intra-Image Correlation Only Flag
POST_CORR<NUM_GROUPS<CORE_SETS>>.Description: This field indicates if the post correlation SPDCF applies only within an image. This flag only applies to Sensor type post SPDCFs as Platform and Payload type post SPDCFs are assumed to apply both within an image and image to-i.

IO_CAL_AP.Name: IO Calibration Adjustable Parameters Flag
IO_CAL_AP.Description: This field indicates whether IO calibration adjustable parameters are included.

NUM_SETS_CAL_AP.Name: Number of Sets of Calibration Adjustable Parameters
NUM_SETS_CAL_AP.Description: This field indicates the number of sets of calibration adjustable parameters.

FOCAL_LENGTH_CAL<NUM_SETS_CAL_AP>.Name: Focal Length Associated with nth Set of Calibration Adjustable Parameters
FOCAL_LENGTH_CAL<NUM_SETS_CAL_AP>.Description: This field indicates the focal length associated with the nth set of calibration adjustable parameters.

NCAL_CPG.Name: Number of CPGs
NCAL_CPG.Description: This field contains the number of CPGs for the calibration adjustable parameters.

CORR_REF_DATE_IO<NCAL_CPG>.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for nth CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_IO<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event event for the nth CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_IO<NCAL_CPG>.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for nth CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_IO<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event event for the nth CPG.

N1CAL<NCAL_CPG>.Name: Number of Calibration Adjustable Parameters in the nth CPG
N1CAL<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field contains the number of calibration adjustable parameters in the nth CPG.

CAL_AP_ID<N1CAL<NCAL_CPG>>.Name: Calibration Adjustable Parameter Identities
CAL_AP_ID<N1CAL<NCAL_CPG>>.Description: This field identifies the jth calibration adjustable parameter in the nth CPG. The parameters have a set numbering, 01 to 11, which corresponds to the ordered set {X0, Y0, K0, K1, K2, K3, P1, P2, P3, A1, A2}. Note: Units of error covariance data are millimeters squared for CAL_AP_ID values 01 to 08, 10, and 11. Error covariance data for ID 09 is unitless.

ERRCOV_C3<(0.5xNUM_SETS_CAL_AP)x(NUM_SET.Name: Kth Individual Calibration Adjustable Parameter Error Covariance Term Within jth Set of nth CPG
ERRCOV_C3<(0.5xNUM_SETS_CAL_AP)x(NUM_SET.Description: This field identifies the jth calibration adjustable parameter in the nth CPG. The parameters have a set numbering, 01 to 11, which corresponds to the ordered set {X0, Y0, K0, K1, K2, K3, P1, P2, P3, A1, A2}. Note: Units of error covariance data are millimeters squared for CAL_AP_ID values 01 to 08, 10, and 11. Error covariance data for ID 09 is unitless.

CAL_INTERP<NCAL_CPG>.Name: Interpolation Type for nth CPG
CAL_INTERP<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field contains the calibration adjustable parameter interpolation type for the nth CPG. A value of 0 indicates nearest neighbor interpolation and a value of 1 indicates linear interpolation.

SPDCF_ID_TIME<NCAL_CPG>.Name: SPDCF Identifier for nth CPG in the Time Dimension
SPDCF_ID_TIME<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field indicates the SPDCF identifier for the nth CPG in the time dimension.

SPDCF_ID_FL<NCAL_CPG>.Name: SPDCF Identifier for nth CPG in the Focal Length Dimension
SPDCF_ID_FL<NCAL_CPG>.Description: This field indicates the SPDCF identifier for the nth CPG in the focal length dimension.

TS_CAL_AP.Name: Time Synch Calibration Adjustable Parameters Flag
TS_CAL_AP.Description: This field flags whether time synch calibration adjustable parameters are included.

NUM_TS_GRP.Name: Time Synch Parameter Type Flag
NUM_TS_GRP.Description: This field identifies the type of time synch parameters used in this CSCSDB DES. The types are: 1: One group of both position and attitude delta time adjustable parameters. There is no focal length time adjustable parameter. 2: Two groups, one for each position and attitude. There is no focal length time adjustable parameter. 3: One group of position, attitude, and focal length delta time adjustable parameters. 4: Two groups: one containing position and attitude, and one containing focal length delta time adjustable parameters. 5: Three groups: one for position, one for attitude, and one for focal length delta time adjustable parameters.

CORR_REF_DATE_TS.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 1 Time Synch CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TS.Description: This field identifies the date of last de-correlation event for this type 1 synch CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TS.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 1 Time Synch CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TS.Description: This field identifies the time of last de-correlation event for this type 1 synch CPG.

TSRR.Name: Time Sync Covariance Elements
TSRR.Description: This field contains an element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix, where TSRR: Element (1,1), i.e., the first element.

TSRC.Name: Time Sync Covariance Elements
TSRC.Description: This field contains an element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix, where TSRC: Element (1,2), i.e., the second element.

TSCC.Name: Time Sync Covariance Elements
TSCC.Description: This field contains an element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix, where TSCC: Element (2,2), i.e., the third element.

TS_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 1 Time Synch CPG
TS_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 1 time synch CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSP.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 2 Time Synch Position CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSP.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 2 time synch position CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSP.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 2 Time Synch Position CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSP.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 2 time synch position CPG.

TS_POS_COV.Name: Type 2 Time Sync Position Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_POS_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch position calibration error covariance value.

TS_POS_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 2 Time Synch Position CPG
TS_POS_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF identifier for this type 2 time synch position CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSA.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 2 Time Synch Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSA.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 2 time synch attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSA.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 2 Time Synch Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSA.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 2 time synch attitude CPG.

TS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 2 Time Sync Attitude Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch attitude calibration error covariance value.

TS_ATT_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 2 Time Synch Attitude CPG
TS_ATT_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 2 time synch attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TS.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 3 Time Synch CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TS.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 3 time synch CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TS.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 3 Time Synch CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TS.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 3 time synch CPG.

TS_POS_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Position Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_POS_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch position calibration error covariance value.

TS_POS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Covariance Parameter Between Position and Attitude Adjustable Parameter
TS_POS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch covariance parameter between position and attitude adjustable parameter value.

TS_POS_FL_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Covariance Parameter Between Position and Focal Length Adjustable Parameter
TS_POS_FL_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch covariance parameter between position and focal length adjustable parameter value.

TS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Attitude Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch attitude calibration error covariance value.

TS_ATT_FL_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Covariance Parameter Between Attitude and Focal Length Adjustable Parameter
TS_ATT_FL_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch covariance parameter between attitude and focal length adjustable parameter value.

TS_FL_COV.Name: Type 3 Time Sync Focal Length Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_FL_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch focal length calibration error covariance value.

TS_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 3 Time Synch CPG
TS_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF identifier for this type 3 time synch CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSPA.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 4 Time Synch Position and Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSPA.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 4 time synch position and attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSPA.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 4 Time Synch Position and Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSPA.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 4 time synch position and attitude CPG.

TS_POS_COV.Name: Type 4 Time Sync Position Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_POS_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch position calibration error covariance value. This value represents the first element, (1,1), of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix.

TS_POS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 4 Time Sync Covariance Parameter Between Position and Attitude Adjustable Parameter
TS_POS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch covariance parameter between position and attitude adjustable parameter value. This value represents the second element, (1,2), of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix.

TS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 4 Time Sync Attitude Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch attitude calibration error covariance value. This value represents the third and final element, (2,2), of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 Time Synch Calibration Error Covariance matrix.

TS_PA_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 4 Time Synch Position and Attitude CPG
TS_PA_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF identifier for this type 4 time synch position and attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSFL.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 4 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSFL.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 4 time synch focal length CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSFL.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 4 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSFL.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 4 time synch focal length CPG.

TS_FL_COV.Name: Type 4 Time Sync Focal Length Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_FL_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch focal length calibration error covariance value.

TS_FL_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 4 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
TS_FL_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 4 time synch focal length CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSP.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Position CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSP.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch position CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSP.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Position CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSP.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch position CPG.

TS_POS_COV.Name: Type 5 Time Sync Position Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_POS_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch position calibration error covariance value.

TS_POS_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 5 Time Synch Position CPG
TS_POS_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 5 time synch position CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSA.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSA.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSA.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Attitude CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSA.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch attitude CPG.

TS_ATT_COV.Name: Type 5 Time Sync Attitude Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_ATT_COV.Description: This field contains the time synch attitude calibration error covariance.

TS_ATT_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 5 Time Synch Attitude CPG
TS_ATT_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 5 time synch attitude CPG.

CORR_REF_DATE_TSFL.Name: Date of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
CORR_REF_DATE_TSFL.Description: This field contains the date of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch focal length CPG.

CORR_REF_TIME_TSFL.Name: Time of Last De-Correlation Event for this Type 5 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
CORR_REF_TIME_TSFL.Description: This field contains the time of the last de-correlation event for this type 5 time synch focal length CPG.

TS_FL_COV.Name: Type 5 Time Sync Focal Length Adjustable Parameter Covariance
TS_FL_COV.Description: This field is the time synch focal length calibration error covariance value.

TS_FL_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for this Type 5 Time Synch Focal Length CPG
TS_FL_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF indentifier for this type 5 time synch focal length CPG.

UE_FLAG.Name: Unmodeled Error Flag
UE_FLAG.Description: This field indicates the presence of unmodeled error data in this instance of the CSCSDB DES.Note: Unmodeled error data are tied to unwarped image space if a CSWRPB TRE is populated.

LINE_DIMENSION.Name: Number of Grid Points in the Line Dimension
LINE_DIMENSION.Description: This field reports the number of grid points in the line dimension where unmodeled error data is provided.

SAMPLE_DIMENSION.Name: Number of Grid Points in the Sample Dimension
SAMPLE_DIMENSION.Description: This field reports the number of grid points in the sample dimension where unmodeled error data is provided.

URR<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Name: Unmodeled Error Covariance Element (1,1)
URR<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Description: This field contains the first element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 unmodeled error covariance matrix associated with the jth sample of the nth line of the unmodeled error grid.

URC<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Name: Unmodeled Error Covariance Element (1,2)
URC<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Description: This field contains the second element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 unmodeled error covariance matrix associated with the jth sample of the nth line of the unmodeled error grid.

UCC<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Name: Unmodeled Error Covariance Element (2,2)
UCC<LINE_DIMENSION<SAMPLE_DIMENSION>>.Description: This field contains the third and final element of the upper triangular portion of the 2 X 2 unmodeled error covariance matrix associated with the jth sample of the nth line of the unmodeled error grid.

LINE_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for Unmodeled Error in the Line Dimension
LINE_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF identifier for unmodeled error in the line dimension.

SAMPLE_SPDCF.Name: SPDCF Identifier for Unmodeled Error in the Sample Dimension
SAMPLE_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the SPDCF identifier for unmodeled error in the sample dimension.

SPDCF_FLAG.Name: SPDCF Flag
SPDCF_FLAG.Description: This field is a flag indicating if SPDCF data is provided in this instance of the CSCSDB DES.

NUM_SPDCF.Name: Nuumber of SPDCFs
NUM_SPDCF.Description: This field contains the number of SPDCFs.

SPDCF_ID<NUM_SPDCF>.Name: Nth SPDCF Identification Number
SPDCF_ID<NUM_SPDCF>.Description: This field contains the SPDCF ID for the nth SPDCF stored in this instance of the CSCSDB DES.

SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>.Name: Number of Constituent SPDCFs Associated with the nth SPDCF ID
SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>.Description: This field contains the number of constituant SPDCFs assiciated with the nth SPDCF ID.

SPDCF_FAM<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: SPDCF Family Identification
SPDCF_FAM<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field identifies the family of the jth constituent SPDCF.

SPDCF_WEIGHT<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: Weighting of the jth Constituent SPDCF
SPDCF_WEIGHT<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the weighting value associated with the jth constituent SPDCF; all weights associated with a given SPDCF_IDn shall sum to 1.

FP_A<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: CSM Four Parameter Correlation Function Parameter A
FP_A<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter A of a CSM four parameter correlation function.

FP_ALPHA<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: CSM Four Parameter Correlation Function Parameter alpha
FP_ALPHA<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter alpha of a CSM four parameter correlation function.

FP_BETA<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: CSM Four Parameter Correlation Function Parameter beta
FP_BETA<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter beta of a CSM four parameter correlation function.

FP_T<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: CSM Four Parameter Correlation Function Parameter T
FP_T<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter T of a CSM four parameter correlation function.

NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: Number of Segments in the Piece-Wise Linear Correlation Model
NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field contains the number of piece-wise linear correlation model segments which are associated with the jth constituent SPDCF.

PL_MAX_COR<NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>>.Name: Piece-Wise Linear Function Segment Maximum Correlation Value
PL_MAX_COR<NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>>.Description: This field contains the maximum correlation value over the kth segment. Note that the first PL_MAX_CORnjk value must be greater than zero and all successive values must be less than the preceding value. Note also that the correlation value of the last segment is constant in value and has unbounded length.

PL_TAU_MAX_COR<NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDC.Name: Piece-Wise Linear Function Difference (Tau Segment Value)
PL_TAU_MAX_COR<NUM_SEGS<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDC.Description: This field contains the starting difference value for the kth segment. Note that the first PL_TAU_MAX_CORnjk value must be equal to zero and that all successive values must be greater than the preceding value.

DC_A<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: Damped Cosine Correlation Function Parameter A
DC_A<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter A of a damped cosine correlation function.

DC_T<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: Damped Cosine Correlation Function Parameter T
DC_T<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter T of a damped cosine correlation function.

DC_P<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Name: Damped Cosine Correlation Function Parameter P
DC_P<SPDCF_P<NUM_SPDCF>>.Description: This field provides the value for parameter P of a damped cosine correlation function.

DIRECT_COVARIANCE_FLAG.Name: Direct Covariance Flag
DIRECT_COVARIANCE_FLAG.Description: This field indicates if a posteriori adjustable parameters and variance-covariance matrix data are provided.

DC_TYPE.Name: Direct Covariance Type Flag
DC_TYPE.Description: This field indicates the type of direct covariance. This field has been designed to support the future expansion of this set; the current value shall be set to 0 and future values coordinated with NTB.

NUM_PARA.Name: Total Number of Adjustable Parameters Described in the Covariance Support Data
NUM_PARA.Description: This field indicates the total number of adjustable parameters described in the covariance support data.

ADJ<NUM_PARA>.Name: Nth Adjustable Parameter Value Obtained from an External Adjustment
ADJ<NUM_PARA>.Description: This field indicates the nth adjustable parameter value obtained from an external adjustment.

ERRCOV_C4<(0.5xNUM_PARA)x(NUM_PARA+1)>.Name: Individual Adjustable Parameter Error Covariance Terms
ERRCOV_C4<(0.5xNUM_PARA)x(NUM_PARA+1)>.Description: This field contains the nth individual adjustable parameter error covariance term from the upper triangular portion of the error covariance matrix generated in support of the a posteriori adjustment.

RESERVED_LEN.Name: Length of Reserved Field
RESERVED_LEN.Description: The value of this field shall be 000000000.
